title: G18: offline provenance integrity gate with adversarial rejection tests
public_pr_body:
Adds an offline manifest verifier linking artifact/profile to exact checkout/executed SHA, exit, SQL hash, UTC times, environment, complete counts, identity fields and retained log bytes/hash. Requires all prod/realistic/x100 profiles to be explicitly synthetic. Fourteen named adversarial tests pass on committed reviewer code 9d580c6d; preserves the earlier file-level reporter output rather than miscounting it.

Refuses wrong heads, nonzero exit, absent profile/ID/log/hash, empty/skipped results, localhost-only identity, real-data flag and reversed times. Does not execute commands or connect to databases. Metadata assertions and hashes cannot establish truth by themselves: independent execution/creation journals remain required.

Actual Code artifact map/profiles not supplied and remain NOT VERIFIED. Original run logs, exact commit/environment/UTC/SQL manifest/exit and hashes retained. Handover: tests/reviews/b5-g18/B5-G18-REVIEW.md.

- [x] Separate owned reviewer branch; original failures retained; source/lint/type/whitespace checks scoped in report. Raw logs kept byte-for-byte, including original whitespace.
- [ ] Independent owner assessment, actual final-candidate runtime evidence and authorised acceptance remain open.

Explicit Rhys overnight allocation. New b5 test/tool/review files only; no Claude-owned source/test edits, #359 branch modification, ISO pack work, Ready label, main merge, production migrations/wipe/import/counter change, deployment, live AI/automated email or message to John. PRs targeting #359’s branch are review follow-ups only; no merge is requested. Production actions remain subject to Rhys’s separate approval.
